_schema_note: Runtime state for /auto-phase skill. File written to .claude/auto-state/<phase>.json (gitignored). Updated every tick. Read at session resume to route to current stage handler.
_schema_v2_note: v2 (additive, forward-only) adds the stage-digest ring (stage_digests + digest_overflow_path). Phase 0.5 Step A backfills the v2 fields to their empty defaults ([] / null) on resume against a v1 state file, mirroring the error_class_history backfill. No v1 field semantics change.
_schema_v3_note: v3 (additive, forward-only) adds the uniform tool-output spill guard (spill_dir) and auto-handover refresh pointers (last_handover_path + last_handover_at). Phase 0.5 Step A backfills the v3 fields to their empty defaults (derived spill_dir / null handover fields) on resume against older state files. No v1/v2 field semantics change.
_resume_fields_note: session_id is a random 12-char hex assigned per advisor session. last_session_ended_at is set when a session detects clean shutdown signals (rare); usually null because compaction/restart is abrupt. resume_count increments on every Phase 0.5 reconciliation pass — high values (>3) suggest the user is restarting often, possibly indicating a stage-routing bug worth investigating at retro time.
_last_known_phase_tip_note: Updated on every state-changing tick to the SHA of the phase branch tip the skill last observed. Used in Phase 0.5 Step D to detect mid-session daemon-side finalize-merges that completed while the advisor session was down.
_error_class_history_note: Per advisor-orchestrator.md §5.3 cycle-count meta-rule. Each entry: {workflow_run_id, error_class, file, ts}. Appended on every result: fail; count ≥3 same (error_class, file) → catch-fire (no fix-impl). File = basename only (line numbers drift). Phase 0.5 Step A backfills [] on resume against older state files.

junior_tasks._note: Map of stage → most recent Junior task id we dispatched for it

_stage_digests_note: Bounded ring (last DIGEST_RING_MAX=12 entries) of compact per-transition digests. Appended on every stage transition AFTER the ledger's stage field is updated. Each entry: {stage, entered_at, outcome (one line), key_ids (cohort/junior/dq/pr ids touched this stage), next_action_hypothesis}. When the ring exceeds 12, the oldest entries are appended (one JSON object per line) to digest_overflow_path and dropped from this array. Read by Phase 0.5 Step E to build the COMPACT resume report as the authoritative active-thread source. Data-only: does NOT gate, route, or change cadence.
_digest_overflow_note: Append-only JSONL overflow for stage_digests beyond the ring cap. Gitignored sibling under .claude/auto-state/ (covered by the existing .gitignore line '.claude/auto-state/'). Path is illustrative; the skill sets it to .claude/auto-state/<phase>.digests.jsonl.
_spill_dir_note: Directory for the uniform tool-output spill guard. Any tool result over SPILL_THRESHOLD_CHARS (default 16000) is written here as <stage>-<tool>-<UTC-iso>.txt; only head+tail+path are kept in context. Generalises the per-tool size mitigations (PMD broad-search spill per pmd-search-strategy.md, DQ log_slice cap, cargo-output-capture). Gitignored sibling under .claude/auto-state/. Path is illustrative; the skill sets it to .claude/auto-state/<phase>.spill/.
_last_handover_note: Path to the most recent auto-emitted handover (refreshed on each stage transition from the latest stage_digests entry + durable ledger fields). Default location .claude/PRPs/handovers/<phase>-auto-<UTC-date>.md (tracked, advisor-owned per CLAUDE.md canonical handovers path; committed with a chore(advisor): subject). Satisfies the advisor-orchestrator.md §1 pre-compact handover discipline automatically. last_handover_at is the ISO8601 of the last refresh.
